GLAD is an OpenGL loader-generator from https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad

The simplest way to regenerate the .h and .c files is to use the glad web service at http://glad.dav1d.de/

1) Go to http://glad.dav1d.de/

2) Set these fields:
    Specification: OpenGL
    Profile: Core
    API:
        gl 4.5
        gles1 none
        gles2 none

3) Under Extensions, on the right hand side, click Add All

4) Click Generate

5) Overlay the downloaded files into external/glad/...

If the web service no longer exists at http://glad.dav1d.de/, you can get the generator code at
https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad and run it locally.
